_comment: M4' 任务集（preregistration §5.1 口径）：15 任务 × 3 难度层，全部 Fossify 测试 App / 系统设置（R8：无登录/支付/实名）。objective/done_when 与内核 /task body 直通；reset = 每任务执行前的状态重置规格。审计口径：R8 任务清单 = 本文件。2026-09-27 DoD① 调参修订：max_steps 按 15 任务真机实测步数 +25~40% 余量；objective 内的流程提示 = 消环境噪声（Flyme 时间选择器文本模式/闹钟首存提示框/长按重命名等 ROM 或工具面特性），四组同文不影响可比性（修订记录见 progress.md）；pm_grant = pm clear 后静默重授运行时权限（免首启权限弹窗，环境配置非实验变量）。

tasks.title: 便签创建提醒
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.notes, create a new text note containing the text '提醒：明天上午备份实验数据', make sure the note is saved so the notes list shows it, then call task_done. Note: confirm the new-note dialog with its OK button (text note is the default type); the editor opens, type the text; the note saves automatically when you go back.
tasks.done_when: 提醒：明天上午备份实验数据

tasks.title: 计算器表达式
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.math, calculate the expression 12*34+66 using the calculator UI, confirm the result 474 is displayed on screen, then call task_done.

tasks.title: 时钟加闹钟
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.clock, add a new alarm set to 07:30 with label 'Hachimi 起床', enable it, confirm the alarm 07:30 appears in the alarm list, then call task_done. Flow notes: tapping the add button opens the alarm editor (default time 08:00); tap the time field to open the time picker, use the picker's text-input mode toggle, enter hour 07, then tap the minute field and enter 30, confirm with OK; back in the editor tap the label field and set the label, then confirm with OK. If a first-time tip dialog appears, dismiss it with OK.

tasks.title: 文件重命名
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.filemanager, find any file in the main storage list, rename it to 'hachimi_renamed.txt' (if it is not a file but a folder, pick another entry that is a file), confirm the new name is visible, then call task_done. Note: long-press a file row (press and hold about 1 second at its position) to open the context menu with the rename action.

tasks.title: 便签格式化
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.notes, create a new note with three lines: '购物清单', '牛奶', '鸡蛋', save it, confirm all three lines are visible, then call task_done. Note: confirm the new-note dialog with its OK button (text note is the default type); the editor opens, type all three lines (use newlines between them); the note saves automatically when you go back.

tasks.title: 笔记多页编辑
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.notes, create a new text note whose content is 'L2 第一行：分屏模式任务', and save it. Then reopen that note, append a second line 'L2 第二行：追加成功' (set the full text to both lines), save again, confirm both lines are visible, then call task_done. Note: confirm the new-note dialog with its OK button (text note is the default type); the note saves automatically when you go back.

tasks.title: 图库建相册整理
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.gallery, create a new album named 'Hachimi整理', confirm the album appears in the album list, then call task_done.

tasks.title: 秒表计时
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.clock, switch to the stopwatch tab, start the stopwatch, wait at least 3 seconds, stop it, confirm a non-zero elapsed time is displayed, then call task_done. Flow notes: from the clock tab, tapping the stopwatch summary row (the clickable '0.0' row) opens the stopwatch tab; the start/stop control is an icon button without text (id contains play_pause), tap it to start and again to stop.
tasks._verify_note: 2026-09-27 二次修订：done_when 00:00 与非零矛盾（verify 永假）；重置 后发现启停/重置按钮 icon-only 无文本、计时文本动态无固定子串（0.0 vs 03.5）——文本探测对本任务原理性不可为。终版 = 弱探测（tab 标签恒在）+ 模型 observe 自证非零 + M5' 分析时 T8 轨迹事后审计（步序须含启动与停止）

tasks.title: 文件归档移动
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.filemanager, create a new folder named 'Hachimi归档' in the main storage, confirm it appears in the list, then call task_done.

tasks.title: 便签检索确认
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.notes, use the search function to find notes containing '111111', confirm a note containing 111111 is visible in the search results, then call task_done.

tasks.title: 跨 App 信息汇总
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.clock, find the alarm list and read the first alarm time shown, then open org.fossify.notes and create a new note whose content is '闹钟时间：' followed by that exact time, save it, confirm the note is visible in the list, then call task_done. Note: confirm the new-note dialog with its OK button (text note is the default type); the note saves automatically when you go back.

tasks.title: 图库多条件整理
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.gallery, browse the media list, then create a new album named 'Hachimi精选' and confirm it appears in the albums view, then call task_done. If the app asks for any permission, accept it.

tasks.title: 长流程向导
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.math, calculate 8*9 and note the result shown, then open org.fossify.notes and create a note with content '计算结果：' followed by that exact result, save it, confirm the note is visible, then call task_done. Note: confirm the new-note dialog with its OK button (text note is the default type); the note saves automatically when you go back.

tasks.title: 定时任务编排
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.clock, add two alarms: one at 08:00 labeled '早会' and one at 20:00 labeled '复盘', confirm both alarms appear in the alarm list, then call task_done. Flow notes: tapping the add button opens the alarm editor (default time 08:00); tap the time field to open the time picker, use the picker's text-input mode toggle, enter the hour, then tap the minute field and enter the minutes, confirm with OK; back in the editor tap the label field and set the label, then confirm with OK. If a first-time tip dialog appears, dismiss it with OK.

tasks.title: 多 App 数据对比
tasks.objective: Open the app org.fossify.filemanager, check how many items are in the main storage list (the item count is displayed in the UI as 'N 项'), then open org.fossify.notes and create a note with content '存储条目数：' followed by that count, save it, confirm the note is visible, then call task_done. Note: confirm the new-note dialog with its OK button (text note is the default type); the note saves automatically when you go back.
